narrative.overview: A premium Pokémon collecting boutique in warm ivory, near-black ink, and measured Poké Ball red. Editorial serif titles pair with Geist Sans task copy and Geist Mono catalog data. Real card photography leads; the Kanto home map, separate Pueblo Primavera sign-in map, and crisp pixel sprites preserve Pokémon character. The admin console remains independent.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory planes, sand dividers, near-black text, and restrained red actions.
Editorial serif titles, clear sans-serif task text, and monospaced comparable data.
Real card art stays central in a calm, generous collector catalogue.
Pixel art stays in the distinct Pokémon maps and crisp character sprites.
Accessible focus, responsive layouts, reduced motion, and factual product states.

rules.name: The Measured Red Rule
rules.body: Keep deep red for the main action, focus, and selected markers; leave large surfaces ivory and reserve semantic colors for outcomes.

rules.name: The Editorial Type Rule
rules.body: Use serif display titles, Geist Sans for reading and controls, and Geist Mono for comparable commerce data.

rules.name: The Collector Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate paper, cards, and controls with warm-neutral layering, fine outlines, and restrained depth.

dos: Use ivory, ink, and restrained red across customer routes.
Keep serif display, sans task text, and mono catalog data distinct.
Preserve separate Kanto and Pueblo Primavera maps and crisp sprites.
Keep real merchandise images, prices, stock, condition, and card identifiers visible.
Keep customer design tokens out of the independent admin system.
donts: Do not restore the large circle behind the authentication character.
Do not apply pixel type, thick frames, hard shadows, or yellow primary actions to customer controls.
Do not substitute decorative Pokémon art for catalog merchandise.
Do not invent service guarantees or product claims.
